answer: Reef's identity network uses a vine of unique social connections to enforce one-person-one-vote. Each new identity must sponsor a real person who loses a small stake if the new identity is caught cloning, so an attacker pays a concrete per-identity cost of one lost sponsor stake. Honesty stays cheaper than cloning because every duplicate instantly forfeits that sponsor stake, making honest registration costless. A quill records each verified identity to prevent fraud.
